thesis: This episode argues that while AI presents potential benefits for Google like improved ad performance, it remains an open question whether AI constitutes a new platform or merely an enabler. The speaker suggests that Google's search product must endure changes to stay relevant, but it is unclear if these shifts will leave the company with a worse business or if it will be a better business in five or ten years. Consequently, a conservative investor should not make Herculean assumptions about Google's ability to navigate these competitive changes.
